description.title: About Our Farm
description.text: Nestled in MithilaBihari, Laxmi Bahu-Uddeshya Matsya Tatha Pashupakshi Palan Farm is dedicated to cultivating the finest varieties of organic dragon fruits. We practice sustainable, pesticide-free agriculture to bring you fruits that are not only delicious but also packed with nutrients, antioxidants, and pure natural goodness.

story.title: Our Story
story.text: Growing up in a farming family, I always knew I wanted to stay connected to the land. After researching dragon fruit cultivation, I decided to take the leap and start my own farm. With support along the way from KOICA, the farm grew. Today, we focus on clean, responsible agriculture—growing high-quality dragon fruit without heavy pesticides or harmful chemicals. Along the way, we've been able to create steady jobs for local workers, proudly supplying fresh produce to our local community and markets across Kathmandu. Naturally grown. Locally harvested.
